title: New Delhi to Host BWF Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in 2028
indian_angle: India will host the prestigious BWF Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in New Delhi in 2028, marking a significant event for Indian badminton.
summary: New Delhi has been selected to host the BWF Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in 2028, featuring the 3x15 scoring and best-of-three match format. India last hosted the premier team competition in 2014.

title: Prannoy Bows Out of Syed Modi International at Home
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Prannoy exited the Syed Modi International 2026, ending his campaign at a home event.
summary: Indian player Prannoy was defeated in straight games (21-19, 21-17) at the Syed Modi International 2026, despite a brief fightback in the second game.

title: Indian Women's Hockey Team Achieves Historic World No. 4 Ranking
indian_angle: The Indian women's hockey team has made history by reaching its highest-ever FIH World Ranking at No. 4, showcasing the nation's growing prowess in the sport.
summary: The Indian women's hockey team has climbed to a historic World No. 4 position in the latest FIH Rankings, following 13 consecutive wins and an undefeated streak of 14 matches, including strong performances in the ongoing Women’s Asian Champions Trophy.

title: India Sweeps League Stage, Reaches WACT 2026 Semifinals
indian_angle: The Indian women's hockey team continued its dominant run, sweeping the league stage of the WACT 2026 and securing a spot in the semifinals against Malaysia.
summary: India defeated Japan 4-0 to maintain a perfect record and advance to the semifinals of the Women's Asian Champions Trophy 2026, where they will face Malaysia.

title: Gukesh Draws Game 2 in World Chess Championship After 20 Moves
indian_angle: Indian chess prodigy Gukesh played out a draw in the second game of the FIDE World Chess Championship 2026, maintaining an even score in the early stages of the prestigious event.
summary: Indian Grandmaster Gukesh agreed to a draw against Sindarov in the second game of the FIDE World Chess Championship 2026 after just 20 moves, despite holding a stronger position.
